description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin named 'contextmenu' that adds custom context menu functionality, including handling browser-specific behaviors and integrating with CKEditor's plugin architecture.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.contextMenu
classes.description: A class representing the custom context menu behavior within CKEditor, handling event binding and menu display.

methods.name: addTarget
methods.description: Adds a target element for the custom context menu, handling browser-specific event behaviors.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the context menu at specified coordinates relative to the offset parent.
